subject: Can't log in after holiday
body: Back from leave and my password doesn't work anymore. It says the password has expired.
resolution: Guided user through self-service password reset (KB-001). Resolved in 10 minutes.

subject: Outlook says disconnected
body: Outlook on my laptop shows disconnected at the bottom, webmail is fine.
resolution: Signed out of Office and back in. Profile rebuilt remotely when that did not help (KB-004).

subject: Whole office lost internet
body: None of us can get online since about 9am, phones are also down.
resolution: Fibre provider outage in the area. Failed over to the 4G backup link, raised a fault with the provider.

subject: Weird email from our CEO asking for gift cards
body: Got an email that looks like it's from our CEO asking me to buy gift cards urgently. I haven't replied.
resolution: Confirmed phishing, user had not clicked anything. Blocked sender domain and removed the email from all mailboxes (KB-010).

subject: Entered my password on a fake DocuSign page
body: I opened a DocuSign link and typed my password before I realised it wasn't real.
resolution: Escalated to security on-call. Password reset, sessions revoked, malicious inbox rule found and removed (KB-011).

subject: New starter Monday
body: We have a new accounts assistant starting Monday, needs a laptop and access to the finance mailbox.
resolution: Account and licence created, finance mailbox access approved by manager, spare laptop prepared (KB-014).

subject: Quote for two monitors
body: Can we get a price for two 27 inch monitors for the design team?
resolution: Quote sent within one business day, accepted and delivered the following week (KB-016).

subject: Accounting system won't open for anyone
body: Our accounting software gives a database connection error for all users.
resolution: SQL service on the application server had stopped after a Windows update. Service restarted, update issue logged (KB-018).

subject: VPN not connecting from home
body: My VPN says the gateway cannot be reached. Internet at home works fine.
resolution: Saved password in the VPN client was out of date after a recent change. Updated and connected (KB-008).

subject: Printer jammed again, third time this week
body: The upstairs printer keeps jamming every few days, we've cleared it three times now.
resolution: Worn pickup roller identified as the cause. Part ordered through the printer vendor and replaced.

subject: Accidentally deleted a project folder
body: I deleted the Henderson project folder from SharePoint yesterday by mistake.
resolution: Restored from the SharePoint recycle bin (KB-017).

subject: Please open port for new camera system
body: Our security camera vendor needs a firewall port opened so they can view the recorder remotely.
resolution: Change approved by client. Vendor access set up through a restricted VPN account instead of an open port.

subject: Lots of MFA requests on my phone
body: My phone keeps getting approve sign in requests that I didn't make.
resolution: User had denied all requests. Password reset, sessions revoked, sign-ins from overseas blocked (KB-012).

subject: Staff member leaving Friday
body: Sam finishes on Friday at 5pm. Please give his manager access to his email after he leaves.
resolution: Account blocked at 5pm Friday, mailbox converted to shared and delegated to manager (KB-015).

subject: Fortinet advisory question
body: Saw a news article about a FortiGate SSL VPN vulnerability. Are we affected?
resolution: Checked firmware version against the advisory. Firewall was vulnerable, emergency patch applied the same day (KB-019).

subject: Mailbox full can't send
body: Outlook says my mailbox is full and emails are bouncing back.
resolution: Cleared deleted items and large sent attachments. Online archive enabled (KB-020).
